lines.x: Need me to make you some midnight snacks, Boss?
Here you go, Boss. And this. You mentioned it before... Everyone says I have a good memory, but I don't know.
When I'm off… I practice cooking. Not just seafood. What do you like to eat, Boss?
Errr… Boss, is it usually on me to find something to talk about?
Boss, if you ever want to see a Lungmen night market, I can take you. It's fun... but not exactly safe.
Boss Lady Kal'tsit gave me special permission to use Rhodes Island's supply channels. Now I can try some new stuff. Any requests, Boss?
I had Officer Hoshiguma on me for a while, for a couple of reasons... But I know she was just looking out for me, same as the neighborhood aunties and uncles.

I've been told that with my looks, my good memory and knife skills, I was born to be a villain. I don't like that, and I've struggled to find a proper way to change myself. But after coming to Rhodes Island, I realized I should just live my own life.
Boss, do you think there's any way to put my memory to good use...? I never thought about it before, but it would be nice if I could help.
Bo... Oh, you're asleep. I'll just keep reading then.
Hey, Boss. I'm Jaye. Officer Hoshiguma said I'd be better off working here, so here I am. I know seafood, I can cook, and I'm pretty good with a knife. I think I can help.
Oh... so cooking and warfare are pretty alike…
Boss, does this mean I can expand my stall a bit more?
Boss, I figured it out. If you just treat the enemy like fish, then fighting is a lot easier.
I forgot to close up…
I know how to lead a fishing crew.
Hm? We're going?
That's a lot.
Yeah?
Right here.
I'll try.
Ughh...
Scale.
Gut.
Clean.
Slice.
Boss, did we just do something special?
Boss, is it... is it over?
Boss, should we go after them?
Boss, I think we should probably run.
I don't know if there's a suitable place to set up my stall…
Hm?
Boss, I wonder if you have any food preferences...?
Arknights.

I used to always have to close up the stall late, but now all of a sudden it's a holiday. Can't say I'm used to it... Boss, you want some late-night chow? I'm a little hungry myself. I can cook something for us both.
Hey Boss, you're looking good today.
It's your birthday today, Boss. Big day. I always remember it, but I'm no good at presents... How about I make you something to eat? Whatever you want, I'll whip it up.

When Officer Hoshiguma said I should come to Rhodes Island, I was ready to work my hands to the bone. Then I realized, I may not get paid as much as I thought I would, but the work's also easier than I thought, so I guess it balances out... I'll keep doing my best, Boss.
